status: source-controlled short jib club and raised three-dimensional jib pose
units: full-size feet; model Y is negative forward

club.note: Short tapered spar under the aft part of the jib foot. It does not extend forward to the tack or the full foot.

jib_pose.note: The clew follows the source club aft end, raising the jib bottom above deck. The S08 foot and 42-ft plan leech remain plan dimensions; the raised straight 3D chord is recorded explicitly.

excluded: The old full-foot club running from the bowsprit tip to the clew is withdrawn; it is not the source club.
